latestVersion.changelog:
Lobster Distill v1.0.5 — skill changelog

- Updated the recommended admin/relay message format in docs. The "share" output must now fit a standardized two-section template: a clearly marked admin summary, followed by clean agent instructions.
- Expanded README and SKILL.md usage instructions to emphasize this exact relay template, reducing admin/agent confusion and errors.
- Minor documentation and instruction tweaks to clarify forwarding and receiving workflows for both humans and agents.
